sentences.text: Shri Aditya Khare - Advocate for the appellants.

Ms. Shweta Ydav - Deputy Advocate General for the respo
Heard on I.A. No.17828/2025, which is first application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C./430(1)
of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to
appellant No.2 Arti Shukla.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 23.08.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge,
(POCSO), Katni, in S.C. No.54/2022, whereby, appellant No.2 Arti Shukla has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
Sentence Sentence Imprisonment in lieu Conviction Section Imprisonment Fine Section of fine 366 (3) r/w Section Section 3 r/w 109 I.P.C. and 4(2) & 17 R.I. for 20 years Rs.2000/- R.I. for 6 Months Section 3 r/w 4(2) POCSO Act & 17 POCSO Act 376 (2)(n) r/w Section 109 I.P.C. Section 5 (L) and Section 5 (L) r/w 6 & 17 R.I. for 20 years Rs.2,000/- R.I. for 6 months r/w 6 & 17 POCSO POCSO Act Act 363 r/w Section 109 Section 366 r/w I.P.C. and Section 109 I.P.C R.I. for 03 years Rs.1,000/-
R.I. for 3 months 366 r/w 109 I.P.C

Learned counsel for the appellant submits there are general and omnibus 2 CRA-7192-2025 allegations against appellant No.2 that she had asked main accused Yash @ Ashu Dwivedi to take the victim to Goa.
There is no overt act ascribed to the appellant No.2.

Hence,
prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release her on bail.
Ms. Shweta Yadav, learned Deputy Advocate General, support the impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant No.2- Arti Shukla and release her on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for her appearance before the trial Court 18.12.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant No.2 Arti Shukla.
shall remain suspended and she be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
